motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: --ease-out: the tab underline, the stamp landing, the rule animations and toast entry.

motion.name: state-colour
motion.purpose: Background, border and text colour changes on buttons, fields, rows, segments and navigation (CSS ease-out keyword).

motion.name: stamp-land
motion.purpose: The return stamp lands once after grading: opacity 0 and scale(1.12) to rest.

motion.name: rule-grow
motion.purpose: Each filled progress segment grows from the left once (scaleX 0 to 1).

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Toast entry: fade in from opacity 0 and translateY(-6px).

motion.name: toast-out
motion.purpose: Toast exit (data-leaving): fade out and rise 6px.

motion.name: rule-travel
motion.purpose: Loading rule and boot rule: a one-third bar travels translateX(-100%) to translateX(300%).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: every animation and transition collapses to 0.01ms; the boot rule stops.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one next step on a screen: Start review, Start session, Submit answer, Next question, Continue session.

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.25rem; font-family: "Libre Franklin", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #9d8cff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-ghost svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-btn-ghost { width: 2.5rem; padding: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-inkSoft, #c8c8c8); } .ds-btn-ghost:not(:disabled):hover { background: var(--color-sunken, #202020); color: var(--color-ink, #ececec); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions: delete sessions, delete all data. Red label at rest, a 10% error tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.25rem; font-family: "Libre Franklin", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #9d8cff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-danger svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--color-surface, #181818); border-color: var(--color-lineStrong, #6b6b6b); color: var(--color-errorInk, #ff6b5f); } .ds-btn-danger:not(:disabled):hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-error, #ff6b5f) 10%, var(--color-surface, #181818)); border-color: var(--color-error, #ff6b5f); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Bordered input with a label above and a hint below; focus doubles the border with a 1px ring.
components.html: Add one topic at a time, e.g. "AP Biology" or "Chapter 3". Press Enter to add.
components.css: .ds-field-wrap { max-width: 24rem; font-family: "Libre Franklin", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink, #ececec); } .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-lineStrong, #6b6b6b); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--color-surface, #181818); color: var(--color-ink, #ececec); font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--color-inkMuted, #a3a3a3); opacity: 1; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--color-inkSoft, #c8c8c8); } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-focus, #9d8cff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-focus, #9d8cff); } .ds-field-hint { margin: 0.375rem 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; color: var(--color-inkMuted, #a3a3a3); }

components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 14.5rem; padding: 1.5rem 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--color-shell, #0c0c0c); border-right: 1px solid var(--color-line, #2a2a2a); font-family: "Libre Franklin", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { padding: 0 0.625rem; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-shellInk, #ececec); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; margin-top: 2rem; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 0.25rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-shellMuted, #a3a3a3); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; stroke-width: 1.75; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--color-shellInk, #ececec); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shellInk, #ececec) 7%, transparent); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: var(--color-primary, #5b43d6); color: var(--color-onPrimary, #ffffff); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #9d8cff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Tags
components.description: Small status labels on Inset; tinted accent, success and error variants with inked text.
components.html: ActiveCorrectIncorrectMediumReview
components.css: .ds-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: "Libre Franklin", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; white-space: nowrap; padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border-radius: 0.125rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; background: var(--color-sunken, #202020); color: var(--color-inkSoft, #c8c8c8); } .ds-tag-accent { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #9d8cff) 16%, var(--color-surface, #181818)); color: var(--color-accentInk, #9d8cff); } .ds-tag-success { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success, #3fbf74) 14%, var(--color-surface, #181818)); color: var(--color-successInk, #6fd896); } .ds-tag-error { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-error, #ff6b5f) 13%, var(--color-surface, #181818)); color: var(--color-errorInk, #ff6b5f); }

components.css: .ds-panel { max-width: 22rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #2a2a2a); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--color-surface, #181818); color: var(--color-ink, #ececec); font-family: "Libre Franklin", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line, #2a2a2a); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-panel-callno { white-space: nowrap; font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", "Libre Franklin", sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-inkSoft, #c8c8c8); } .ds-panel-body { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; } .ds-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 0.5rem 1rem; margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; } .ds-facts dt { color: var(--color-inkMuted, #a3a3a3); } .ds-facts dd { margin: 0; text-align: right; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Lembrion is a conventional study-app shell with one library ritual laid over it. The shell is the category standard: a left sidebar from 1024px (a top bar below that), a page title beside the date, and calm bordered panels on a neutral, untinted ground. The ritual is the loan. Every question and every session carries a call number like a spine label (`ORG·3`, `CEL/LEA`), questions that come back for review are listed on a date-due slip, and each one is marked with a date stamp in narrow caps: violet when it is due, red when it is overdue, faded while it is still out, grey once it is returned.

The density is that of a circulation ledger. Numbers live in tables with small caps column heads, hairline rows and right-aligned tabular figures; progress figures are set in Archivo Narrow; loan periods are drawn to their true length on one 0–30 day axis, and each session's answered questions are drawn as a bar on one shared scale, so lengths can be compared across rows and pages. Colour is spent sparingly: stamp violet marks what is due, actionable or current; slip red prints the due slip's header and marks what is overdue, and doubles as the error hue; green and amber only report state. Dark is the default palette; Light, System and High contrast are one click away in the theme menu, and all of them share one set of token names.

The world is flat. PRODUCT.md binds it to no skeuomorphism: a date stamp is a 1.5px frame of narrow caps, not an inked rubber impression; there are no gradients, glow, icon tiles or rounded bubbly cards, nothing is rounder than 6px, and the only shadow in the system belongs to things that float (menus, dialogs, toasts).
keyCharacteristics: A standard shell: a 14.5rem sidebar whose current route is a filled violet label, and a 3.5rem top bar below 1024px.
Panels with 1px hairline borders and 6px corners on a neutral grey ground; no shadow on content.
A call number in Archivo Narrow caps on every question and session.
Date stamps in a 1.5px frame: violet due, red overdue, faded not yet due, grey returned or retired.
The "Due for return" slip: the review queue under a red printed header rule and red column heads.
Loan periods and extent bars drawn to exact length on shared axes.
Libre Franklin for the interface, Archivo Narrow for marks and figures; hierarchy by size and weight.

rules.name: The Due-or-Actionable Rule
rules.body: Violet marks only what is due, actionable or current: the current route, primary buttons, selected segments and tabs, selected choices and options, due stamps, due and not-yet-due loan shares, the current progress segment, the loading rule, links and the "Active" status. It never fills a panel, a heading, a tag at rest, or decoration.

rules.name: The Slip Red Rule
rules.body: Red prints only the due slip's header and column heads and marks what is overdue; everywhere else it means an error or a wrong answer. It is never a decorative accent, and never a second action colour.

rules.name: The Ink Twin Rule
rules.body: Every signal hue has an ink twin. The base (`accent`, `success`, `error`, `warning`) fills rules, bars and tints; text and stamp frames in that hue always use the `*Ink` token, which holds at least 4.5:1 on Panel in every palette.

rules.name: The Tint, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: State surfaces are tints mixed into Panel with `color-mix(in srgb, <hue> N%, var(--color-surface))`: correct option (success 13%), wrong option (error 11%), success note title (success 10%), error note title (error 9%), error notice (error 9%), warning notice (warning 12%), accent tag (accent 16%), success tag (success 14%), error tag (error 13%), danger button hover (error 10%), pressed suggested model (primary 11%). A selected choice or option is neutral (Inset with a 1px Due Violet inset outline). The only solid fills are primary buttons, the current route, selected segments, progress segments, loan shares, extent segments, the loading bar and toast rules.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Libre Franklin sets the interface; Archivo Narrow is reserved for the circulation marks and figures: call numbers, date stamps, figures, option keys and the "Enter" key hint. Narrow never sets body text, headings or buttons.

rules.name: The Size-and-Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is size and weight (400 through 800) plus Muted Ink for secondary text. Uppercase and tracking belong only to printed labels (column heads and group labels at 0.08em), call numbers (0.05em), stamps (0.06em) and the key hint; negative tracking only to the wordmark, page titles, the slip title and the question. No kickers or eyebrows above titles.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every count, score, percentage, ratio, date and stamp sets in tabular figures and right-aligns in number columns and fact values. Ratios are written with spaced slashes ("0 / 1", "3 / 5"); lists and metadata join with " · ".

rules.name: The One Measure Rule
rules.body: Reading text never runs wider than 68ch. Tables and two-column frames may use the full 76rem; prose may not.

rules.name: The Reading Order Rule
rules.body: Phones read the panels in DOM order, and wide layouts only place them. The slip always follows Progress: second in the phone stack, the full-width middle row from 1280px.

rules.name: The Overlays-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this floats above the page". Panels, the slip, tables, notes and every other piece of content sit flat; if it does not float, it does not cast.

rules.name: The Three Radii Rule
rules.body: 2px for marks, 4px for controls, 6px for containers; nothing rounder, and no pills.

dos: Do put every route in the 76rem page frame beside the sidebar (under the top bar on phones), open it with one `page-title` and its lede, and group its content in panels with a 1px Hairline border and 6px corners.
Do give each screen one Stamp Violet primary button for the next step; make every other action secondary or ghost.
Do tag every question and session with its call number, and mark every scheduled question with a date stamp: violet due, red overdue, faded not yet due, quiet once returned.
Do keep violet for what is due, actionable or current, and set violet, green, red and amber text in the `*Ink` tokens.
Do draw lengths to scale on a shared axis: loan periods on the 0–30 day axis, extent bars against the most answered session.
Do set counts, scores, ratios, dates and stamps in tabular figures, right-aligned in tables and facts lists.
Do show grading as a tint mixed into Panel plus inked text, and keep every option, the user's pick, the correct answer and the explanation visible after grading.

Do style through the semantic tokens (`bg-surface`, `text-ink-muted`, `border-line-strong`) so all three palettes follow; build tints with `color-mix()` in CSS, because the token classes take no `/opacity` modifier.
Do show any AI wait as the 3px loading rule with a one-line label.
donts: Don't use skeuomorphic texture, gradients or glow; PRODUCT.md rules out skeuomorphism, so the stamp stays a flat frame of caps.
Don't build rounded bubbly cards, icon tiles or stat tiles; numbers belong in tables, facts and figures, and nothing is rounder than 6px.
Don't put a shadow on content; only menus, dialogs and toasts carry the overlay shadow.
Don't use violet as decoration, or red for anything but the slip's print, overdue and errors.
Don't add a coloured side stripe to notices, notes or panels; state is a tint plus inked text.
Don't set body text, headings or buttons in Archivo Narrow, or uppercase anything but printed labels, call numbers, stamps and the key hint.
Don't put kickers or eyebrows above titles.
Don't hard-code hex in components; every colour comes from a `--color-*` token so the three palettes stay whole.
